title: Understanding How Enterprises Adopt the Model Context Protocol for LLM-Driven Software Engineering
title_zh: 企业如何采用 Model Context Protocol 进行 LLM 驱动的软件工程：实践理解
abstract_en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in AI-based software engineering, but their limitations in complex task execution and multi-tool coordination have driven growing interest in the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Existing research has mainly focused on MCP's technical design, with limited empirical evidence on how it is adopted and used in enterprise practice, particularly with regard to deployment challenges, operational risks, and practitioner expectations. To address this gap, we conducted semi-structured interviews with 20 practitioners from eight companies in the Internet and financial sectors. The findings show that MCP is valued for supporting cross-system collaboration, task decoupling, and knowledge reuse in LLM-based workflows, but its adoption remains constrained by ecosystem fragmentation, cross-component coordination difficulties, and unresolved problems in distributed state management and fault diagnosis. Participants also expressed strong demand for better standardization, lower adoption barriers through low-code or plugin-based approaches, and more systematic operational support. These results provide early empirical evidence on enterprise MCP practice and offer practical implications for improving MCP's standardization, usability, and deployment readiness in real-world software engineering environments.
abstract_zh: 随着 Large Language Models (LLMs) 在 AI-based software engineering 中的应用不断增加，其在复杂任务执行和多工具协同方面的局限性推动了业界对 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的关注。已有研究多聚焦于 MCP 的技术设计，缺乏关于企业实际采用与使用 MCP 的经验证据，尤其是在部署挑战、运维风险和从业者期望方面。为弥补这一空白，作者对来自互联网和金融领域 8 家公司的 20 名从业者进行了半结构化访谈。研究发现，MCP 在 LLM 工作流中被认为有助于跨系统协作、任务解耦和知识复用，但其落地仍受生态碎片化、跨组件协调困难，以及分布式状态管理和故障诊断问题未解决等因素制约。受访者还强烈期待更好的标准化、更低门槛的低代码或插件式接入方式，以及更系统的运维支持。该研究为企业 MCP 实践提供了早期经验证据，并对提升 MCP 的标准化、可用性和真实软件工程环境中的部署成熟度提出了实践启示。
key_points_zh: 研究方法：通过半结构化访谈调研来自互联网和金融行业 8 家公司的 20 名实践者，关注 MCP 在企业 LLM-driven software engineering 中的采用情况。
核心价值：企业认为 MCP 有助于支持跨系统协作、任务解耦和知识复用，从而增强 LLM 工作流中的多工具协调能力。
主要挑战：MCP 采用受到生态碎片化、跨组件协同复杂、分布式状态管理困难和故障诊断能力不足等问题限制。
实践需求：受访者期待更强的标准化、更低门槛的 low-code 或 plugin-based 接入方式，以及面向企业部署的系统化运维支持。
研究意义：论文提供了关于企业 MCP 实践的早期实证证据，为改进 MCP 的可用性、标准化和部署就绪度提供参考。

llm_assessment.comment: Useful empirical evidence on enterprise MCP adoption and operational pain points, but it is observational rather than a new harness mechanism.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该文提供了企业采用 MCP 的实证观察和运维痛点，但不是新的 harness 机制性贡献。
